summary: Iteration 105 — Home feed Shop-category chip FILTERING + real venues from marketplace_profiles via new GET /api/shell/venues + Shop page bottom-banner/floating-FAB relayout. All 8 acceptance criteria PASS on both backend (pytest 8/8) and web frontend (demo@bigfm.dubai). Backend counts: chip_restaurant=4, beauty=2, fitness=1, retail=1, offers/shop=8 — exactly as specified. Sponsored-first ordering verified. Home chips filter the venue shelf (Eat 4 / Salons 2 / Fitness 1 / Shops 1), first card of the filtered row shows a SPONSORED pill (verified on Eat: 'Fun Pizza Kitchen'). Radio 14 chip switches feed to a 14-tile station grid. VenueCard onOpen navigates to /shop/{business_id}. On /shop the merchant banner sits AFTER the last venue section (y=3435 vs last-section y=2981) and the Order-by-chat FAB is position:fixed, pinned right, links to /shop/concierge.

issues: Minor: floating 'Order by chat' FAB (bottom:112px, right:16px) sits close to the MiniPlayer's right-side controls (points-pill / favorites). On narrow desktop widths (<=1280) and mobile it may visually crowd the MiniPlayer. Not a blocker — worth checking bottom offset once MiniPlayer variants are considered.

critical_code_review_comments: backend/routes/shell.py:19 — _NON_TEST is defined at module load with the regex inline; a shared pattern (_TEST_NAME already exists on line 16) is defined but unused. Minor: use _TEST_NAME.pattern to avoid duplicated regex string and keep drift-free.

backend/routes/shell.py:150 shell_venues — no `status=approved` filter documented but the code applies it (line 160). Confirm the frontend expects only approved shops (it does). Also, `limit` param is uncapped — recommend clamping to <=100 to avoid abuse (currently the .find(...).limit(200) hard-caps upstream, so effectively safe, but explicit min/max via Query would be cleaner).

frontend/src/Home.jsx:62 — `orderVenues` re-sorts client-side (b.sponsored - a.sponsored) even though the backend already returns sponsored-first. Not incorrect but duplicated work; consider trusting backend order to keep the client stable and reduce dead code.

frontend/src/Home.jsx:145 — venuesGrid path uses `.filter(o => (o.category||'').toLowerCase() === catToken)`. Since the backend already supports `category=` param, hitting /api/shell/venues?category=cat_x would let you skip the client-side filter and always show up to 8 per category (currently limited to 24 default + client filter, which for Fitness/Shops still fits). No user-facing bug today (only 8 total venues) — but if data grows, some categories could show fewer than expected because they were filtered out AFTER the top-24 slice. Recommend re-querying the endpoint with the chip category param on chip change.

frontend/src/design_radiolife/screens/ShopRadioLife.jsx:300 — shop-concierge-fab uses `bottom-28` (7rem = 112px). MiniPlayer height is ~64–72px; FAB sits ~40px above it. On very short viewports the FAB may cover the bottom of the last content section. Acceptable for now.

frontend/src/design_radiolife/screens/ShopRadioLife.jsx is 308 lines and rolls up header/menu/search/near-me/categories/sort/browse/usual/specials/sections/banner/FAB in one component. Approaching maintainability threshold; consider splitting the account-menu popover and the specials/sections rows into sub-components.
